newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada moves next two T-bill auction dates.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada moves next two T-bill auction dates.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Tuesday said it will change the date of this year's two remaining T-bill auctions.

Next week's auction, which would normally be held on a Tuesday, will be held on Monday, December 23, 1996. The bills sold at the auction will be dated and delivered on Friday, December 27, rather than the usual Thursday.
The year's final auction will be held on Monday, December 30, with bills settling on Friday, January 3, 1997.
The Bank said the auction dates are being changed because of the Christmas and New Year holidays. The auctions will return to their usual schedule in the new year.
